# Product Proposal: Savings Goal Feature

## 1. Summary
We propose adding a Savings Goal feature to the existing mobile banking app. Customers can name a goal and schedule automatic transfers from their chequing account to their existing savings account. This is a feature for the existing retail customer base.

## 2. Customer Segment
Available to existing retail customers who already hold both a chequing and a savings account. No new customer segment.

## 3. Geographies
Canada only. Domestic transfers between the customer's own accounts.

## 4. Channel and Technology
Delivered through the existing mobile channel. No third party is involved; the feature is built in-house on the existing core banking platform.

## 5. Transaction Characteristics
Transaction type is internal transfer between own accounts. Expected average transaction value is CAD 150 with a maximum scheduled transfer of CAD 2,000. Expected transaction volume is 40,000 transfers per month.

## 6. Controls
Transfers are between accounts owned by the same verified customer, so sanctions screening is not applicable. Monitoring coverage: internal transfers are covered by the existing account activity monitoring scenarios.

## 7. Process
No operational process change. Existing customer support handles enquiries.
